scope: Synthetic Bayesian demapper counterexample, not FastSET, DeepRx, LDPC or hardware measurement
counterfactual: Retain the first two BPSK resource elements at identical times, frequencies and powers; omit the parity observation.
what_is_proved: Deleting an output LLR does not in general remove information already used by a data-aided front-end. Recompute on the retained observation set.
limitations: This deletion frees a resource element, not a shortened block or higher modulation MCS.
No front-end AGC, RF nonlinearities or cross-RE interference.
Demapper marginalizes independent data priors and does not exploit the parity check explicitly.
